title: Amelia | Crisp Azure Stripe Blouse
bodyHtml:
A modern blouse that's equal parts polished and effortless. This striped shirt pairs a vibrant blue base with clean vertical and horizontal lines, giving you that put-together look without any fuss. It's the kind of piece you'll reach for again and again—whether you're heading to the office or meeting friends for brunch in the city.

Why you'll love it

  • Bold geometric stripes that feel contemporary, not fussy
  • Soft, breathable fabric that won't cling or feel heavy through warm days
  • Relaxed fit with a button-down front—easy to style and easy to wear
  • Pairs beautifully with white trousers, denim, or a neutral skirt
  • Machine washable and low-maintenance, because life's too busy for fussy care
  • Works just as well dressed up for smart occasions as it does casual outings
  • That rare find—a striped blouse that actually feels fresh every time you wear it

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
